models.name: Xinsir ControlNet OpenPose SDXL 1.0
models.description: SDXL OpenPose ControlNet used to stabilize body orientation, pose and multi-limb composition while the prompt controls character and scene.

capabilities.pose_strength: strong when the source image yields a usable human skeleton
capabilities.composition_strength: strong for body pose and orientation

notes: Use the control image for pose and orientation. Keep the prompt responsible for character identity, outfit, expression and scene.

known_limits: OpenPose does not control clothing details, face identity or depth; detection quality depends on the supplied source image and the preprocessor.

validation.scope: named-API OpenPose route
validation.visual_fidelity: Not established until an SFW route probe completes; control success means graph execution and pose-conditioning plumbing, not exact character likeness.

models.name: comfyui_controlnet_aux OpenPose preprocessor

known_limits: Preprocessor weights are cached under the pinned custom node; a first request may download them and take longer.

validation.scope: OpenPose preprocessing node

models.name: Official Anima Turbo v1.1
models.description: Official CircleStone Labs Anima Turbo v1.1 diffusion checkpoint. This is the highest-precision published Turbo file in the official Anima repository; it is kept as a separate route from Moody for direct comparison.

capabilities.identity_strength: weak-to-medium from prompt; no identity adapter bundled
capabilities.precision_scope: BF16 diffusion weights; shared Qwen text encoder and Qwen image VAE are separate dependencies

prompting.dialect: ordered natural-language description with optional Danbooru-style tags
notes: The official model card documents both tag and caption training; use lowercase tags and keep subject count/identity near the beginning.
prompting.negative_prompt_effectiveness: Ineffective at CFG 1; negative conditioning requires guidance above 1.

known_limits: Turbo is distilled for 8-12 steps at CFG 1 and trades some diversity for stability; it is not a character-specific checkpoint.

validation.scope: official Anima Turbo v1.1 checkpoint in named API graph

notes: Use a clear single-person portrait. The adapter is reference conditioning, not a prompt replacement and not a pixel-locked face recognizer.
